game_concept: A tower defense set in Shadow Cave – Underground River, a black underground river: the shadow ranger must handle cave spiders while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Digit Mill: Peel digits off a number with while n > 0 using // and %.
theme: Shadow Cave – Underground River: a black underground river
core_gameplay_loop: In Underground River, repeat each round: Peel digits off a number with while n > 0 using // and %. Each round, cave spiders strike the rope bridge, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the digits value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the rope bridge from cave spiders in Underground River: keep the digits meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 46-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: digits drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 46-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 10 (extended tier): Digit Mill
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Digit Mill' (Week 4 slot 13), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Underground River'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how digits changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against cave spiders in Underground River.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 46 seconds while digits > 0.
